Remove Raspberry Pi OS first-boot setup that conflicts with Rugix.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

<dl class="parameter-list">

<dt>

`disable_swapfile`

</dt>
<dd>

Default: `"true"`

Remove dphys-swapfile. Use true or false.

</dd>

</dl>

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value    |
| ------------ | -------- |
| Priority     | `950000` |
| Dependencies | None     |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set unless `before` or
`after` constraints require otherwise. Dependencies include other recipes
without ordering them.

## Behavior

Disables the Raspberry Pi OS user-configuration and one-time resize services,
removes userconf-pi, and disables automatic initramfs handling in the boot
configuration. It runs before `core/pkg-update` and `core/pkg-upgrade` so
package operations use the adapted system.

Sets `MODULES=most` in `/etc/initramfs-tools/conf.d/rugix` before removing
packages. This prevents initramfs generation from trying to detect the target
hardware inside the build chroot. The setting remains in the image so package
operations in later layers can also regenerate initramfs.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/rpi-raspios-cleanup"]
```
